$comment: Provenance for every vendored data file. Nothing enters this directory without an entry here.
Two rules: (1) only sources whose license permits redistribution in a permissively-licensed
package, which in practice means US Government works; (2) every file is checksummed, and the
catalog generator refuses to run if a checksum does not match. The vendored data is the root of
trust for every control claim this library makes, so changing it must be a deliberate,
reviewed act rather than a silent drift.
Sources with restrictive licenses (notably the Secure Controls Framework crosswalk, CC BY-ND)
must not be vendored here, nor consulted to generate content, even for development only.
